pad_shear_asymmetry — DRIVE pegtactile op

• Data kinds: signal × signal → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pad_shear_asymmetry(qR, qL) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegtactile; pegtactile.pad_shear_asymmetry(qR, qL) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("pad_shear_asymmetry"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

2 パッドの膜のせん断を共通成分(= 軸方向の力、F_z/2 の向き)と差分(= 偶力、M/(2w))に分ける: 共通 = (q_R + q_L)/2、差分 = (q_R − q_L)/2。ratio_v = |差分_v| / (|共通_v| + |差分_v|)(0 = 同じ向き、1 = 純粋な偶力)、opposite_v = v 成分の符号が左右で逆か。Raises ValueError: 有限の 2 成分でない。
